_comment: E2E (manual, live): agent creates a spreadsheet, writes a small table, then formats the header (bold + blue background + white centered) in one turn. Needs GEMINI_API_KEY + DATABASE_URL + OAuth creds in-memory (+ a default parent folder for create) + --agent-session-id. gsheets_format_range is non-destructive (formatting only).

test_payload.prompt: Create a spreadsheet titled 'Inventario demo'. On the first sheet write this table starting at A1: header [Producto, Stock], then rows [Lapices, 10] and [Cuadernos, 5] (use gsheets_set_range). Then format the header row A1:B1 in bold with a blue background (#4472C4) and white centered text using gsheets_format_range. Report the spreadsheet URL and the verbatim result of gsheets_format_range.

config.system_message: You manage Google Sheets. Create the spreadsheet, write VALUES with gsheets_set_range, then STYLE with gsheets_format_range (formatting is a separate step from values). Report tool results verbatim including the URL.
